0022600025.text: The Wizards (4-4) visit the Hawks (5-4) as the Wizards look to end a one-game losing streak, while Atlanta, first in the Southeast, arrives on a two-game winning streak. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee, after surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), with Asa Newell listed as day-to-day with a toe injury and a game-time decision. The Wizards trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 120-105 in Washington on November 4, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
